tex_content.html:
Corollary
[diffeomorphism finiteness under Ricci, diameter, injectivity bounds]

Source: petersen:page-0442, petersen:page-0443 ↗ thm:pet-ch11-anderson-injectivity-radius-controls-norm ↗ cor:pet-ch11-fundamental-thm-diam-vol-bounded 1. ch11:11.4.4Closed Riemannian $n$-manifolds with $n\ge 2$ and $\Lambda ,D,R>0$ satisfying $|\Ric |\le \Lambda $, $\diam \le D$, $\inj \ge R$ is precompact in the $C^{1,\alpha }$ topology for every $\alpha \in (0,1)$, and in particular contains only finitely many diffeomorphism types.
